title: Feature launch post
goal: Announce a new feature and drive demo requests.
audience: Operations managers at commercial maintenance companies, on LinkedIn.
provided_facts: When a technician calls out sick, it reassigns their jobs across the remaining team in under a minute, respecting skills, locations, and SLA deadlines.
It replaces the 45 minutes a dispatcher spends re-planning by phone.
Available to all customers today at no extra cost.
constraints: Ends with a clear next step.
success: An ops manager recognizes their Tuesday morning in the first two lines.
